import Mathlib

open MvPolynomial

/- Prove that any multivariate polynomial $P(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n)$ with real coefficients can be expressed as the difference of two multivariate polynomials $Q(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n)$ and $R(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n)$, both with real coefficients, such that $Q(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n) \geq 0$ and $R(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n) \geq 0$ for all real values of $x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n$. -/
theorem algebra_18 {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} :
    ∃ Q R : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ,
      P = Q - R ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ,
        MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≥ 0 ∧ MvPolynomial.eval x R ≥ 0 := by
results.lean_code:
import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem algebra_18 {n : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} :
    ∃ Q R : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ,
      P = Q - R ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ,
        MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≥ 0 ∧ MvPolynomial.eval x R ≥ 0 := by
  have h_main : ∃ (Q R : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), P = Q - R ∧ ∀ (x : Fin n → ℝ), MvPolynomial.eval x Q ≥ 0 ∧ MvPolynomial.eval x R ≥ 0 := by
    use P ^ 2 + P + 1, P ^ 2 + 1
    constructor
    · -- Prove that P = (P^2 + P + 1) - (P^2 + 1)
      have h₁ : (P ^ 2 + P + 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) - (P ^ 2 + 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) = P := by
        ring_nf
        <;> simp [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm, sub_eq_add_neg]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> simp_all [MvPolynomial.ext_iff]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> norm_num
        <;> aesop
      rw [h₁]
    · -- Prove that for all x, Q.eval x ≥ 0 and R.eval x ≥ 0
      intro x
      constructor
      · -- Prove Q.eval x ≥ 0
        have h₂ : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + P + 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) = (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.eval x P + 1 := by
          simp [MvPolynomial.eval_add, MvPolynomial.eval_pow, MvPolynomial.eval_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_one]
          <;> ring_nf
        rw [h₂]
        have h₃ : (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.eval x P + 1 ≥ 3 / 4 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (MvPolynomial.eval x P + 1 / 2)]
        linarith
      · -- Prove R.eval x ≥ 0
        have h₂ : MvPolynomial.eval x (P ^ 2 + 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) = (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 + 1 := by
          simp [MvPolynomial.eval_add, MvPolynomial.eval_pow, MvPolynomial.eval_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_one]
          <;> ring_nf
        rw [h₂]
        have h₃ : (MvPolynomial.eval x P) ^ 2 + 1 ≥ 1 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (MvPolynomial.eval x P)]
        linarith
  exact h_main

import Mathlib
open Nat

/-Given that $2018$, $106$, and $614$ have the same remainder when divided by a positive integer $n$, find the maximum value of $n$.-/
theorem number_theory_60123 : IsGreatest {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 2018 % n = 106 % n ∧ 106 % n = 614 % n} 4 := by
results.lean_code:
import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem number_theory_60123 : IsGreatest {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 2018 % n = 106 % n ∧ 106 % n = 614 % n} 4 := by
  have h₀ : 4 ∈ {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 2018 % n = 106 % n ∧ 106 % n = 614 % n} := by
    refine' ⟨by decide, _⟩
    -- Prove that 2018 % 4 = 106 % 4
    have h₁ : 2018 % 4 = 106 % 4 := by
      norm_num
    -- Prove that 106 % 4 = 614 % 4
    have h₂ : 106 % 4 = 614 % 4 := by
      norm_num
    -- Combine the results
    exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  
  have h₁ : ∀ n ∈ {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 2018 % n = 106 % n ∧ 106 % n = 614 % n}, n ≤ 4 := by
    intro n hn
    have h₂ : 0 < n := hn.1
    have h₃ : 2018 % n = 106 % n := hn.2.1
    have h₄ : 106 % n = 614 % n := hn.2.2
    have h₅ : n ∣ 1912 := by
      have h₅₁ : n ∣ 2018 - 106 := by
        have h₅₂ : 2018 % n = 106 % n := h₃
        have h₅₃ : n ∣ 2018 - 106 := by
          rw [← Nat.mod_add_div 2018 n, ← Nat.mod_add_div 106 n]
          simp [h₅₂, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod]
          <;>
          (try omega) <;>
          (try ring_nf at * <;> omega)
        exact h₅₃
      simpa using h₅₁
    have h₆ : n ∣ 508 := by
      have h₆₁ : n ∣ 614 - 106 := by
        have h₆₂ : 106 % n = 614 % n := h₄
        have h₆₃ : n ∣ 614 - 106 := by
          rw [← Nat.mod_add_div 614 n, ← Nat.mod_add_div 106 n]
          simp [h₆₂, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod]
          <;>
          (try omega) <;>
          (try ring_nf at * <;> omega)
        exact h₆₃
      simpa using h₆₁
    have h₇ : n ∣ 12 := by
      have h₇₁ : n ∣ Nat.gcd 1912 508 := Nat.dvd_gcd h₅ h₆
      have h₇₂ : Nat.gcd 1912 508 = 24 := by norm_num
      have h₇₃ : n ∣ 24 := by simpa [h₇₂] using h₇₁
      have h₇₄ : n ∣ 1404 := by
        have h₇₅ : n ∣ 2018 - 614 := by
          have h₇₆ : 2018 % n = 614 % n := by
            rw [← h₃]
            <;> simp [h₄]
          have h₇₇ : n ∣ 2018 - 614 := by
            rw [← Nat.mod_add_div 2018 n, ← Nat.mod_add_div 614 n]
            simp [h₇₆, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod]
            <;>
            (try omega) <;>
            (try ring_nf at * <;> omega)
          exact h₇₇
        simpa using h₇₅
      have h₇₈ : n ∣ Nat.gcd 24 1404 := Nat.dvd_gcd h₇₃ h₇₄
      have h₇₉ : Nat.gcd 24 1404 = 12 := by norm_num
      have h₇₁₀ : n ∣ 12 := by simpa [h₇₉] using h₇₈
      exact h₇₁₀
    have h₈ : n ≤ 4 := by
      have h₈₁ : n ∣ 12 := h₇
      have h₈₂ : n ≤ 12 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) h₈₁
      interval_cases n <;> norm_num at h₃ h₄ ⊢ <;>
        (try omega) <;>
        (try
          {
            simp_all [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
            <;> omega
          })
      <;>
      (try
        {
          norm_num at h₃ h₄ ⊢
          <;> omega
        })
    exact h₈
  
  have h₂ : IsGreatest {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 2018 % n = 106 % n ∧ 106 % n = 614 % n} 4 := by
    refine' ⟨h₀, _⟩
    intro n hn
    have h₃ : n ≤ 4 := h₁ n hn
    exact h₃
  
  exact h₂

            <;> field_simp [h₉]
            <;> ring

        <;> ring
        <;> field_simp [h₄]
        <;> ring
        <;> linarith
    have h₁ : Even (λ x => F x * (1 / (a ^ x - 1) + 1 / 2)) := by
      rw [even_iff]
      intro x
      have h₂ := h₀ x
      simpa using h₂

        rw [h₅₂]
        have h₅₄ : F x = 0 := h₃
        rw [h₅₄]

        <;> ring_nf

        <;> field_simp [h₃₂, sub_eq_zero, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg]

          linarith

        <;> field_simp [h₄₁, h₄₂, h₄₃, sub_eq_zero, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg]

        <;> field_simp [h₈₁, h₈₂, sub_eq_zero, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg]
